landing.headline: Appointments, patients, finance and messaging for your clinic
landing.body: A secure workspace for clinic owners, reception, cashiers and doctors.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email and password for your staff account.
login.errorInvalid: Enter a valid email and password.
login.errorRateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.pendingNotice: This clinic is waiting for licence verification. Appointments, consultations and patient messages stay disabled until the platform approves it.
overview.suspendedNotice: This clinic is suspended. Contact the platform team.
overview.noClinicBody: Your account is not an active member of any clinic. Ask the clinic owner for an invitation, or contact them if your access was suspended.
overview.closedNotice: This clinic is closed. Its records are archived and kept.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Clinic owners and invited staff each use their own personal account.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with upper- and lower-case letters and a digit.
register.confirmEmail: Check your email and open the confirmation link, then sign in to continue.

newClinic.title: Register a clinic
newClinic.description: You will be the clinic owner. The clinic stays pending until the platform verifies its licences.
newClinic.name: Clinic name
newClinic.acceptDisclaimer: I have read and accept this notice on behalf of the clinic.

onboarding.ownerOnly: Only the clinic owner can manage licences.
onboarding.title: Licences & verification
onboarding.pendingIntro: Upload the clinic operating licence and the doctor's professional licence. The platform team reviews them before the clinic can start operating.

stateIntro.active: Your clinic is verified and active.
stateIntro.suspended: Your clinic is suspended. Contact the platform team.

onboarding.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
onboarding.uploaded: Uploaded. It will be reviewed by the platform team.

staff.noAccess: You don't have permission to manage staff in this clinic.
staff.title: Staff
staff.inviteDescription: The invitation link works once, for 7 days, and only for the invited email address.
staff.inviteCreated: Invitation created. Send this link to the employee — it is shown only once:
staff.deactivateHint: Access ends immediately. Deactivation cannot be undone; history is kept.
staff.permissionsDescription: Only you, as owner, can assign roles and change permissions.
staff.managerCanManageStaff: Managers can invite, suspend and deactivate receptionists, cashiers and doctors.

manage.on: Managers can invite, suspend and deactivate receptionists, cashiers and doctors.
Managers can manage appointments, requests and the queue for all doctors.

invite.title: Clinic invitation
invite.description: Join a clinic workspace with your personal account.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in or create an account with the email address the invitation was sent to.
invite.summary: You are invited to join {clinic} as {role}.

status.invalid: This invitation link is not valid.
status.used: This invitation has already been used.
status.revoked: This invitation was cancelled by the clinic.
status.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the clinic for a new one.
status.email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that address.

admin.title: Platform administration
admin.reasonOptionalForApproval: Reason (required to reject or request a replacement)
admin.activateHint: Activation requires both licences approved. The 14-day trial starts now.

doctors.title: Doctors & schedules
doctors.noAccess: You don't have access to doctor schedules.
doctors.addDescription: Choose a staff member with the doctor role (or yourself, if you practise).
doctors.noCandidates: Invite a doctor from the Staff page first.
doctors.onlineDescription: Patients can request a time through a public page. Every request waits for reception's approval.
doctors.policyDescription: These rules apply to this doctor's sessions only.
doctors.weeklyDescription: Times are in Cairo local time. Changes regenerate future sessions that have no bookings.
doctors.policyFirst: Save the booking rules first; sessions are created once the booking method is chosen.
doctors.exceptionsDescription: A day off cancels that day's sessions; existing bookings stay listed for reception to handle.
doctors.exceptionHint: Times and places are needed only for extra sessions (places only for queue numbers).

overbooking.label: When a session is full
overbooking.receptionist_override: Reception may overbook with a reason
overbooking.doctor_or_owner_approval: Overbooking needs doctor or owner approval

absentWhenCalled.label: Patient absent when called
absentWhenCalled.move_to_end: Move to the end on return
absentWhenCalled.skip_and_prioritize: Skip now, call first on return

policy.manualOnlyNote: Late arrivals and no-shows are handled manually by reception until the clinic's thresholds are agreed. Patient self-service cancellation needs the patient links that arrive with WhatsApp messaging.

board.cancelSessionHint: Bookings stay listed so you can cancel or rebook each patient.
board.noAccess: You don't have access to appointments in this clinic.

patients.noAccess: You don't have access to the patient registry.
patients.title: Patients
patients.registerDescription: Administrative details only. Medical records are kept by the treating doctor.
patients.noMergeNote: Possible duplicates will be flagged for review in a later release; records are never merged automatically.
patients.duplicatesDescription: Review each pair. Records are never merged automatically.

requests.noAccess: You don't have access to booking requests.
requests.title: Booking requests
requests.intro: Online requests are not bookings until you approve them. Alternatives hold no place: availability is checked again when the patient accepts.
requests.linkCreated: Send this link to the patient (shown once):

publicBooking.title: Request an appointment
publicBooking.unavailable: This clinic is not taking online requests right now.
publicBooking.intro: Choose a time and leave your details. The clinic will confirm your appointment.
publicBooking.noAvailability: No times are available in the next two weeks.
publicBooking.name: Full name
publicBooking.privacy: Your name and mobile number are shared only with this clinic to handle your request.
publicBooking.submitted: Request sent. This is not yet a confirmed appointment — the clinic will contact you.
publicBooking.whatsappConsent: Send me WhatsApp messages about this booking (confirmations, reminders and changes). You can withdraw this at any time by asking the clinic.

offer.title: Proposed appointment
offer.queueNote: This is a queue session: you will receive a reservation number; the time shown is when the session starts.
offer.notHeld: The place is not reserved until you accept, and may be taken by someone else.

outcome.unavailable: Sorry, this time was taken before you accepted. The clinic has been notified and will contact you.
outcome.declined: You declined. The clinic has been notified.

closed.unavailable: This time is no longer available. The clinic will contact you.

consultation.noAccess: Only the treating doctor can open this consultation.
consultation.completeHint: After completion the record cannot be edited; later notes are added as linked corrections.
consultation.archived: Archived information (fields no longer in your form)
consultation.externalDescription: Only with the patient's explicit consent for this visit, after checking their identity. Access ends when this consultation is completed.
consultation.consentStatement: I confirm the patient, present in person, consented to sharing their records from other clinics with me for this visit only.
consultation.history: Your earlier visits with this patient
consultation.externalUnavailable: Access to these records has ended or is not authorised.
consultation.viewOnlyNotice: View only, for this visit. Do not copy or photograph these records.

template.title: My consultation form
template.ownOnly: Each doctor edits only their own form.
template.none: No form yet. Add fields and save to start consultations.
template.label: Field name
template.hint: Saving creates a new version. Values of removed fields stay visible in past records as archived information.

finance.title: Finance
finance.noAccess: You don't have finance permissions in this clinic.
finance.deskNoAccess: Collecting payments needs the owner's permission.
finance.setupNoAccess: Account setup needs the owner's permission.
finance.noDrawer: Ask the owner to create and approve a cash drawer account.
finance.paymentDescription: Manual entry; card, InstaPay and transfers are not verified automatically.
finance.requestDescription: Posted directly or sent for approval, according to the clinic's rules.
finance.handoverDescription: After closing your session, hand the cash over. It moves only when the recipient acknowledges it.
finance.handoverCreated: Waiting for the recipient to acknowledge.
finance.incomingHandover: A cash handover of {amount} is waiting for your acknowledgement.
finance.accountsDescription: Cash drawers, safe, bank, POS and wallets. A new account starts after the owner approves its opening balance.
finance.policiesDefault: Not set yet: everything needs approval until you save rules.
finance.permissionsDescription: Only you, as owner, decide who handles money. Cashiers collect by default.
finance.notTaxDocument: Internal receipt. Not an official tax invoice or e-receipt.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.intro: Transactional appointment messages only, sent to patients who consented. Messages never include medical information.
whatsapp.noAccess: You don't have access to WhatsApp messaging in this clinic.

alerts.budget_80: 80% of the messaging spending ceiling used
alerts.budget_100: Messaging budget reached; further messages are paused
alerts.budget_blocked: A message was not sent because the budget is exhausted
alerts.send_failed: A message could not be delivered
alerts.config_blocked: A message was blocked: template not approved
alerts.connection_down: WhatsApp connection is down; messages are waiting
alerts.patient_reply: A patient replied on WhatsApp; please follow up

whatsapp.connectionDescription: Your clinic's WhatsApp Business number. The access token is stored by operations in the secret store under the reference name; it is never entered here.
whatsapp.noConnection: No WhatsApp number configured. Nothing will be sent.
whatsapp.credentialHint: Ask operations to store the access token as WHATSAPP_TOKEN__<reference>.
whatsapp.settingsDescription: Choose which events send messages. Nothing is sent until you enable it.

eventNames.request_decision: a request is approved or rejected

whatsapp.budgetDescription: Messages beyond the included allowance are sent only within your spending ceiling.
whatsapp.budgetUsage: This month: {used} of {allowance} included messages used
whatsapp.noCeiling: No spending ceiling: nothing beyond the allowance will be sent.
whatsapp.permissionsDescription: Manual sending and budget control are off until you grant them.

manager:messaging.budget: Managers can change the spending ceiling

whatsapp.templatesDescription: Only templates approved by the platform (and by Meta) are sent.

overrideStatus.approved: Your wording is approved and in use

whatsapp.termsDescription: Default monthly allowance and overage price per message until subscription plans define them (open decision OD-B05).
whatsapp.overageUnit: Overage price per message (EGP, empty = no overage)
whatsapp.adminTemplatesDescription: Mark a template approved only after Meta has approved it.
whatsapp.platformNumberDescription: Assign a platform-owned WhatsApp number to a clinic.

billing.title: Subscription
billing.ownerOnly: Only the clinic owner manages the subscription.

stateHelp.none: The trial starts when the platform activates your clinic.
stateHelp.trial: All core features are available during the trial.
stateHelp.grace: Your subscription ended; everything keeps working for up to {days} days. Renew to avoid restrictions.
stateHelp.restricted: New bookings, online requests, WhatsApp messages and doctor activation are paused. All records, consultations and finance remain available, and nothing is deleted.

billing.plansDescription: Plan changes and extra doctor capacity take effect at your next renewal, never earlier.
billing.onlineUnavailable: Online payment is not available yet. Use InstaPay or bank transfer below.
billing.manualTitle: Pay by InstaPay or bank transfer
billing.evidence: Proof of payment (PDF, JPG or PNG)
billing.manualHint: Your subscription changes only after the platform verifies the transfer.
billing.manualSubmitted: Submitted. We will verify it shortly.
billing.notTaxInvoice: This receipt is not a tax invoice.
billing.reverificationRequested: The platform asked for an updated {type}.
billing.pendingDescription: Check the transfer in the bank or InstaPay account before approving. Approval activates the paid period.
billing.adminPlansDescription: Versions are immutable. Clinics keep the terms they paid for until renewal.
billing.settingsDescription: Platform defaults while the commercial terms are being decided (OD-B05).
billing.restrictedBanner: Subscription expired: new bookings and messages are paused. Records remain available.
billing.graceBanner: Subscription ended — renew within the grace period to avoid restrictions.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: The action could not be completed. No changes were saved unless you saw a confirmation. Please try again.
errorPage.notFoundBody: The page does not exist or you do not have access to it.
